steps.text: *sigh*

starting-out-by-talking-to-the-concerned.speaker: Concerned man
starting-out-by-talking-to-the-concerned.text: Fetch me lunch for me then eh, I'm right peckish!

starting-out-by-talking-to-the-concerned.player: I'm a bit busy at the moment.
Yeah, where did you say that crate was again?

starting-out-by-talking-to-the-concerned.speaker: Concerned man
starting-out-by-talking-to-the-concerned.text: It's in the woods just south of here. Carrots all over the place too!

investigation-investigating-curiously-po.player: Hmmm... This crate is full of carrots, and there are more carrots leading off into the trees!

investigation-investigating-conspicuous-.player: More carrots, I must be on the right track.

investigation-investigating-bush-2025-ea.player: This bush is fake, and there's a hole underneath it!
The hole doesn't look like a natural formation, someone or something dug it, so it must lead somewhere...

steps.text: (Player enters the hole.)
(Player enters the hole.)

investigation-talking-to-the-concerned-m.speaker: Concerned man
investigation-talking-to-the-concerned-m.text: Fetch me lunch for me then eh, I'm right peckish!

investigation-talking-to-the-concerned-m.player: I'm a bit busy at the moment.

options.text: Have you seen the Easter Bunny?

steps.player: Have you seen the Easter Bunny lately?

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Indeed I have, he's here! Though he's not his usual self. That's why I'm here actually. It would seem that he has strayed from the path of Easter.

steps.player: That's not good.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: No, not good at all. Especially for those of us who walk the golden-yolked path. As soon as I found out, I set out to track him down.

steps.player: That's nice of you. How did you find him?

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Well as luck would have it, I met a pair of hardy hunters who were up to the task. Glanton and Rinder are their names, and what a help they have been!

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Very capable, though they've yet to tell me what it is they usually hunt.

steps.player: Hopefully not rabbits!

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Don't even think it! They have been nothing but utmost gentlemen. We've been trying to cheer up that poor bunny together.

steps.player: How has that been going?

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Not well. I've tried everything I can think of! Reading our holy Easter books to him, reciting eggy poetry, nothing has worked.

steps.player: Is that really everything you can think of?

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: I also considered egg juggling, but every time I do that I make a big mess.

steps.player: Best leave that to the professionals.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: He's in the next room if you want to talk to him, hopefully you can improve his mood.

steps.player: I hope so too. Talk to you later!
What is this place? Seems a bit... unsavoury.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: This my friend is the Rabbit Hole. A miserable pit for the most part, though I'm told it was previously much more pleasant.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: A home to all Easter-adjacent beings and their friends! Great feasts, parties, and performances were held here.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: All to celebrate Easter! You see, most people would tire of Easter-based activities after a while. But not the denizens of the Rabbit hole.

steps.player: Interesting, so if you felt a particularly eggy urge, you could come here and let loose?

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Precisely! Though now those days are gone, and what Easter joy was once present has all but run out.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Only a few devoted stragglers remain. Though what exactly they are devoted to is up for debate.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Certainly not eggs.

steps.player: That's a shame.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: It is a great shame. Still, there is hope!

steps.player: I agree. I'll have a look around and see what's going on, perhaps I can help restore some egg-nergy.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Oh you! I hope so, let me know if I can help!

options.text: Where are the rest of the egg priests?

steps.player: Where are all the other egg priests?

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: A fine question!

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: They're all very busy scribbling scrolls, rebinding books, replacing plaques, and fiddling with frescoes.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Once we were informed that our beloved 'Ayaster' was actually 'Easter', it became clear that we had a lot of corrections to sort out.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: So they're all making important changes, and there's quite a number to get through!

steps.player: Wow, I don't envy them.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Nor do I! Thank goodness the Easter Bunny is so upset, it's handy excuse to be elsewhere.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: ...That sounded horrible, I didn't mean it like that.

steps.player: I should hope not.
Actually, nevermind.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-wheele.speaker: Wheeler
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-wheele.text: Hi there, nice to see you! Care for a mug of beer?

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-wheele.player: I'm a bit busy at the moment, maybe later.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bella-.player: I'm looking for the Easter Bunny.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bella-.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bella-.text: Fancy that! You're in luck, he's in the next room.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.text: A cock-a-doodle hello to you! Caw!

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.text: I speak for Clarence, and he bids you good day.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.text: The rooster you see before you.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.text: I speak for him, he speaks through me, I speak through her. It is not important.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.text: Yes, you are talking to me.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.player: Which me is that? You or the other one?

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.text: Now I'm lost. Who am I?

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-the-mo.player: This is too confusing, I'll see you later.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-doughp.speaker: Doughphie
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-doughp.text: Can't talk now, pies to make! Bread to bake! Breaks to take!

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-doughp.speaker: Doughphie
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-doughp.text: Far from it, just busy busy busy! Best way to be!

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-cooky-.speaker: Cooky Weasel
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-cooky-.text: Get out of my way stinky! I've got stew to make!

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bowley.speaker: Bowley Moley
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bowley.text: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bowley.speaker: Bowley Moley
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bowley.text: I should set up a moleyball court next, the king of all ball-based sports.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bowley.speaker: Bowley Moley
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bowley.text: Oh nothing. Just thinking out loud.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-bowley.player: Alright I'll leave you to it then.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-rinder.speaker: Rinder
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-rinder.text: Same as you I'd wager, lookin' fer that big ol' bunny.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-rinder.speaker: Rinder
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-rinder.text: That we have kid, that we have.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.speaker: Glanton
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.text: Well met stranger, how do you come to be in this place?

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.player: I'm a friend of the Easter Bunny, I've been looking for him.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.speaker: Glanton
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.text: Is that so? Well that makes you my friend too. Me and Rinder here helped that crazy priest track him down.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.player: I see, that was good of you.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.speaker: Glanton
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.text: I won't lie, it was no selfless act. We've been promised grand rewards.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-glanto.player: It always comes down to eggs!

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.speaker: Fry
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.text: I am Fry, master of dramatics. Player of plays, singer of songs!

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.speaker: Fry
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.text: I put on shows to entertain our patrons.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.speaker: Fry
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.text: At least, I used to. We don't get many punters these days.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.speaker: Fry
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.text: I don't know, Easter isn't as big as it used to be I suppose.

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.player: Well I had to crawl in here through a hole, do you think that's a factor?

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.speaker: Fry
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.text: It wasn't before, but I suppose it could be putting people off...

inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.speaker: Fry
inside-the-rabbit-hole-talking-to-fry.text: Hmm... Maybe we need a door...

talking-to-easter-bunny.player: Easter Bunny! I knew I would find you here.

talking-to-easter-bunny.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-easter-bunny.text: Easter Bunny... Now there's a name I haven't heard in a long time...

talking-to-easter-bunny.player: What have people been calling you instead?

talking-to-easter-bunny.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-easter-bunny.text: Many times have I walked past Varrock West Bank and been called 'Sellin lobbies 200gp'.

talking-to-easter-bunny.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-easter-bunny.text: I don't really understand that one.

talking-to-easter-bunny.player: Do you think perhaps they weren't talking to you?

talking-to-easter-bunny.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-easter-bunny.text: Who could blame them? I'm a failure!

talking-to-easter-bunny.player: Oh come on now, what do you mean?

talking-to-easter-bunny.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-easter-bunny.text: You call me the Easter Bunny? What right do I have to that name?

talking-to-easter-bunny.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-easter-bunny.text: I don't feel the spirit of Easter within me.

talking-to-easter-bunny.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-easter-bunny.text: I'm just a big dumb rabbit!
The Easter Bunny is clearly very upset and needs cheering up. Perhaps the other people in the Rabbit Hole have some ideas?

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-the-e.player: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you feeling?

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-the-e.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-the-e.text: Maybe I'll make my way through this sorry old world as a clown...

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.player: I'm trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, do you have any suggestions?

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.text: Hmm, well, he's a sensible bunny, I'm sure he'd love to go carrot bowling!

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.player: Bowling? Where can we do that?

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.text: It just so happens we have a carrot bowling alley right here in the Rabbit Hole!

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.player: Really? Wow! That's fortunate. Where is it?

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.text: Through the door to the east, turn left, then it's on the right. You can't miss it!

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.text: Well, maybe you can. Depends on your navigational skills I suppose.

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.text: Anyway, talk to Bowley Moley when you get there, I'm sure he will be happy to help.

talking-to-easter-bunny-talking-to-bella.player: Alright, I'll have a look for this bowling alley and speak to Bowley Moley. Thanks!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.speaker: Bowley Moley
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.text: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?

options.text: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.

steps.player: The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?

steps.player: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
I just wonder if we could do anything to help.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Leave it to me boss.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: I also happen to have the ability to...

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: ...Rig the game in his favour.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.

steps.player: Won't he suspect something?

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?

steps.player: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
Bun-itarian..?
Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
Small cutscene ensues...

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?

steps.player: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.

steps.player: Well, here's your chance!

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: And nobody here quite likes bowling.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: They what now?

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!

steps.player: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?

steps.player: We'll see about that.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.

steps.player: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: A fine shot, but not quite enough!

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Watch this!
Thunk
The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.

steps.player: A lucky strike?
I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
And that would be no fun at all.

steps.text: Clang
The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Ah, so you have some fight in you.

steps.player: I could do this all day.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].

steps.player: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: But we should do this again.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?

steps.player: Well, anyway...
It was a close match. How are you feeling now?

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Aye, till next time.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: This is the Rabbit Hole.

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Who me? Nah I'm just a mole.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.speaker: Bowley Moley
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.text: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Well that went well!

steps.player: We may have gotten away with it!

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Oi, not so loud.

steps.player: Don't worry I'm sure those excessively large ears are just for show!

steps.speaker: Bowley Moley
steps.text: Aye reyt.

steps.player: He seems to have more of a spring in his step.
But still not quite himself.
I'll see if anyone else around here can help.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.player: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you feeling?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.speaker: Easter Bunny
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.text: I feel less horrible I suppose...

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.text: Look who it is! I heard the Easter Bunny gave you a true thrashing on that alley.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.player: Oh yeah, I got outplayed fair and square!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.text: It seems to have lifted his spirits somewhat, thanks for doing that.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-bowley-mol.player: I'm just glad to cheer him up a bit.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Hello!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Can I interest you in a drink?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Not right now, thank you. I was wondering if you might be able to help me with something else.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: And what would that be?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Do you know the Easter Bunny?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: I do! He's just over there. Lovely guy.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Does he seem unhappy to you?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Now that you mention it, yes he does.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: He was always so cheery, bouncing around like a fuzzy avatar of joy.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: He's been in a sorry state lately though.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Indeed, I've never seen him like this.
Have you noticed anything odd?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Hmm... He used to drink pint after pint of carrot juice! Barely sips the stuff now though, just stares into the glass.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: He used to LOVE it.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Interesting, could I try the carrot juice please?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Absolutely! One C.J. coming right up!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Euargh! That's...

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Good right? I make it myself.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: It's definitely an experience, how do you make it?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: I put some carrots into a juice press, then add some good old-fashioned elbow grease.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: That would explain the flavour.
Do you have any particularly nice carrots we could use to make some special juice just for the Easter Bunny?
I think he would perhaps appreciate something different.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: You can ask Weasel in the kitchen, he chooses which carrots get used for juice.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Be warned though, he's not much of a people person.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: What do you mean by that?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Oh you'll soon find out! Don't worry though, just tell him I sent you and that you're trying to help the Easter Bunny.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: He'll give you some fantastic carrots.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Once you have them, you can use the juice press to extract their goodness!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Alright, I'll be back soon!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Hello!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Have you been to see Weasel in the kitchen about those nice carrots yet?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Not yet.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Well there's no need to be scared of him! Fetch some carrots and I'll let you use my juice press.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: I'm not scared, I just haven't gotten round to it yet.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: Whatever you say.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.speaker: Cooky Weasel
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.text: What do you want, stinky?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-wheeler-s-.player: Hello to you too. You must be Weasel then.

steps.player: Thanks for the dough.

steps.text: You're welcome!

steps.speaker: Doughphie
steps.text: I need to get back to work now.

steps.player: Okay, I'll talk to you later. Bye!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player lost the dough:

steps.speaker: Doughphie
steps.text: Quick quick, only a moment to spare, what's up?

steps.player: I need more of that yeastier dough.

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.player: Though thinking about it, I don't have enough space at the moment. I'll come back.

steps.speaker: Doughphie
steps.text: Yes yes, come back. Very good.

steps.speaker: Doughphie
steps.text: Alright, alright, here you go. Please keep in mind I'm not made of dough.

steps.player: You look like you are, all covered in flour.

steps.speaker: Doughphie
steps.text: Occupational hazard! You get used to it.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player has not yet done the raisin cutscene:

steps.player: Do you know what raisins are?

steps.speaker: Rinder
steps.text: Raisins? Talk to Glanton, kid. He's your raisin man.

steps.player: Oh, okay then!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player has done the raisin cutscene:

steps.player: Thanks for helping with the raisins.

steps.speaker: Rinder
steps.text: It was no skin off my nose, any time kid.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: I'd like to make some Easter Buns, I don't suppose you have any raisins?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: And why would you think a man like me would have any raisins?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: I'm not sure, I don't actually know what raisins are to be honest.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Well I'll be! Kid, raisins are dried-up grapes.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Oh, well do you have any of those?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Not yet.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Not yet?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: That's what I said.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: As it happens I have a sackful of grapes in my possession.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: How convenient, dare I ask why?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: There are great and terrible beasts in this world kid. We'd been hunting them, and believe me when I tell ye, some of 'em had an awful lot of grapes on their person.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: The slaughter was feverish. We'd cut 'em down and they'd rise up, again and again.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Before we knew it, we'd collected a whole sackful o' grapes!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Seems to me we could make those into raisins, should that align with your intentions.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: What luck! Shall we then?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Well alright, it'll be a long journey though.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Rinder!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: What say ye, Glanton?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Our friend here needs some raisins, let's head to the desert!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Pack yer grapes, then. Let's go.
Cutscene starts: "After a long walk, you reach the desert."

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Here we are.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Here? This big rock?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: This big rock is perfect fer makin' raisins, kid. It's real warm.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: It's as he says kid, real warm.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: We'll leave the grapes here in good clean heat, give 'em time to think about their transgressions.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: I don't remember this rock being here before.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: This rock was always here, before man was, even.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: That you ain't noticed it speaks to yer purview of the world.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: I'm almost certain this is new.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Perhaps more things in this world exist without yer knowledge than with it. Did ye consider that?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Well no, it's just a rock.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Alright alright already! Let's get these grapes going.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: We'd best I suppose. Lay them down and see to their transformation.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Hmm, let's see...

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: I judge these grapes to be...

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: ...Plump and juicy! But not fer long!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: We'll see them desiccated soon enough.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: It is their destiny. A curse on these grapes!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: [player name], You've gotta make the grapes feel bad or they won't shrivel up.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Oh I see, um, curse those grapes! Suffer you foolish berries! Ha!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Now yer gettin' it!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Insufferable fruits! Rank orbs of low repute!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: You tell 'em what for!
Cutscene: "A long while later..."

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Well look at these! Perfect!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Rinder
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: They're a fine example of raisins I'll say.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Great! let's get back to the Rabbit Hole then.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Player is returned to the Rabbit Hole

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Well that was interesting.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Glanton
steps.text: Yes it was, come back when ye have some space and I'll give ye yer share of raisins.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Yes it was. Here's some raisins for yer troubles.
Raisins

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Thank you!
Can I have some raisins please?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player has raisins already:

steps.speaker: Glanton
steps.text: I think ye have enough raisins at the moment.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Glanton
steps.text: Make some space for them and ye can have some more.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Glanton
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Of course, we've plenty to spare after that trip.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Thanks!
I'm making some Easter Buns for the Easter Bunny, and I need some Easter Spices.
Do you have any I could use?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Oh yes of course, we keep plenty behind the bar for cocktails.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Wheeler
steps.text: Of course I can't give you the spices unless you can carry them. Come back when you have space!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Easter spices

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: There you go, I hope they work well!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Thanks!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Wheeler
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: I bet those spices will bring those buns to life!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: Judging by the smell, I'd say so. Powerful stuff.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player is not holding easter spices:

steps.text: You need Easter spices to make Easter Buns.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player is not holding raisins:

steps.text: You need raisins to make Easter Buns.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player is not holding a special egg:

steps.text: You need a special egg to make Easter Buns.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: If the player is not holding yeastier dough:

steps.text: You need some yeastier dough to make Easter Buns.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: You mix all the ingredients together and make some uncooked Easter Buns!

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Eggus Manus
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Easter Buns! Eggy funs! Tasty wasty winky wuns! Oh bunny good and nunny noo..

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Eggus Manus
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Oh hello! I didn't see you there. Off in my own little world I was. How go the buns?

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: I've made them, I just need to cook them.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.speaker: Eggus Manus
cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.text: Chop chop then! I can't stop thinking about them.

cheering-up-easter-bunny-with-eggus-manu.player: All in good time.
Hmmm... I should check in with Eggus before I give one of these buns to the Easter Bunny. Quality control or something.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Eggus Manus
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Do my senses decieve me? Can I smell... Easter Buns?!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Eggus Manus
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Wonderful! Have you tried one yet?
If the player has eaten an Easter Bun:

steps.player: I have! They are fantastic. Great recipe.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: Why, thank you [player name]! How kind!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: If the player has not eaten an Easter Bun:

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Eggus Manus
steps.text: How could you resist such a wonder?

steps.player: I'm not very hungry I suppose.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Eggus Manus
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Let's not delay any longer, get one of these to the Easter Bunny pronto!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Eggus Manus
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: And I would love one too, of course.
Easter bun

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Eggus Manus
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Oh, I'm going to enjoy this!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Eggus Manus
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Simply wonderful! These buns have the Eggus Manus seal of approval.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: Good! I'll take one to the Easter Bunny now.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Rinder
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Good work with those raisins kid, you've got real moxy. Tell me, do you like games?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Rinder
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Runelink! Hah! I mean real games, games with a wager. Pride or humiliation. Stakes worth fighting for.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Rinder
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: There you have it, risk indeed.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Rinder
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Ever been to the wilderness?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Rinder
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Real evil haunts that place...

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Rinder
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: ...And we haunt the evil right back.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Rinder
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: What say ye? Come hasten the reckoning of the horrible legions what dwell up there with us sometime?
If the player has not yet given the bun to the Easter Bunny:

steps.player: Thanks for taking me to make raisins.

steps.speaker: Glanton
steps.text: I was plenty happy to educate ye.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: If the player has given the bun to the Easter Bunny:

steps.player: I used those raisins to make some Easter Buns, and the Easter Bunny really enjoyed them!

steps.speaker: Glanton
steps.text: Well that's great, kid.

steps.player: Thanks again for the help.

steps.speaker: Glanton
steps.text: Any time. You owe me one.

steps.player: Oh, I uh, suppose I do.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Wheeler
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Hello!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Hello...

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: Hi! I'm back with an Easter treat, just for you.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Huh?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Special eh? Why would you give me something special?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: I don't know if I deserve anything.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: Here, it's an Easter bun. Fresh out of the oven.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: An Easter bun? I like those!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Yum! That was lovely. Thanks, [player name].

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: You're a good friend.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: You are most welcome. Do you feel a bit more Easter- ey now?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Oh, I'm starting to remember now! Easter is great! But I just... Hmm, I don't know...

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: I feel like I need one more little treat before I do anything to help with Easter.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: Alright, let me think of something.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: If the player has not talked to Fry yet:

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Excuse me, [player name], I believe I can help you.

steps.player: Oh?

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Come here!

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.

steps.player: Well that's sort of nosey, but go on.

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Let's put on a performance! that will cheer him up.

steps.player: A performance?

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Yes! He's always enjoyed a good show.

steps.player: Well I suppose that could work...

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: I have some classic material we can try if that sounds appropriate?

steps.player: I don't see why not.

steps.speaker: Fry
steps.text: Excellent! I've already talked to some of the other fellows in here about it too. They seem keen!
(Rehearsal cutscene begins.)

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: If the player has talked to Fry already:

steps.player: I wonder how Fry is getting on with that performance...

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: What was that?

steps.player: Oh, nothing. I just need to talk to Fry about something.

steps.speaker: Easter Bunny
steps.text: Oh, see you later then.
(Continues with Fry dialogue.)

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Fry
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Eggus Manus
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Hello!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Eggus Manus
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Indeed he does! Wonderful, isn't it?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: It is, I think we've nearly got him back on track.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: One more treat and I'll be ready to work on Easter again.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Easter Bunny
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: The last one!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Wheeler
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Hello!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: Thanks for both juice and spices, EB really liked the buns!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Hey, [player name]. I thought it was really sweet of you to help cheer up that bunny.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Maybe we could go bowling sometime and you could cheer me up too?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: That would be fun, though I'm quite busy at the moment, and in the near future.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: What about the far future?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: Oh the far future is looking very busy for me.
But if I find the time, we could invite the Easter Bunny too! We'd all have a great game I'm sure.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Bella Le Bowle
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Oh, I see. Nevermind then, if you're so busy.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Ah, hello again, special egg person.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: We, that is to say, I, have decided, that you will receive no more special eggs.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.player: Oh, well I don't actually need any more, so that's fine.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Oh, you aren't devastated? Tormented by this great denial of eggs?

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: Curses!

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: The mouth of Clarence
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: And you're welcome! Cluck.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Doughphie
talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.text: I hope you put that dough to good use.

talking-to-eggus-manus-with-at-least-2-c.speaker: Bowley Moley

steps.text: Other creatures too, as they used to be, and people who've departed long ago. And now I've managed to open my own portal, so I can see it all too, thanks to you!

steps.text: Welcome to the Realm of Memories.

in-the-realm-of-memories-gnome-child.text: If the player completed the 20th Anniversary event:

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: I am so glad you have returned to the Realm of Memories, all these years after our adventure together!

options.text: Why are all the gnomes here green?

steps.player: Why are all the gnomes here green?

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: In my day all gnomes were green, like our trees. Although the world has changed, and gnomes are no longer green, the Short Green Guy cocktail is so named because of this.

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: In fact, Blurberry still instructs his apprentices not to bring him a gnome when he asks for a Short Green Guy!

options.text: So what do you actually do here?

steps.player: So what do you actually do here?

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: The people you see here all dwelt in the world as it used to be, in various different eras. Many such people have faded away into the mists of time, but a lucky few are remembered.

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: They would be glad to meet you, I am sure.

steps.speaker: Gnome Child
steps.text: From the Realm, we watch how the world changes. We see the happy moments, the sad times, the lucky events, the dry streaks. It is a wonderful existence.

steps.player: Thank you.
